reuse.why: Copies the field-clearing update from unlinkAccount instead of extracting a shared local-unlink helper that both unlinkAccount and the new path could call (unlinkAccount itself cannot be called because of the GoCardless removal).

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount block that defines an 'unlinked' account is copied verbatim from unlinkAccount, so the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places.

placement.why: The flag is threaded uniformly through all six providers via the existing shared guard, but the guard named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked now performs a destructive write before the link itself is attempted, mixing validation and mutation.

scope.why: Focused on the flag and its tests; only minor incidental reformatting of two existing test assertions.

maintainability.why: Single entry point for the rule is good, but the misleadingly named guard with a side effect and the copied unlink field list will drift if unlinkAccount changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked: re-does unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount clearing instead of a shared local-unlink helper

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink field list is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's update, not disguised
